title: Kolaboro: what we shipped each day
description: One item per UTC day with the changes shipped to kolaboro.com, from the git history of the live site.

items.title: 5 November 2026: 62 changes shipped so far
items.content_text:
- Image-index.json and the technology render check no longer show developer domains or project names (anonymity rule); matches link to the image check tool's anonymous ids
- Sitemap index split by type and language, country hubs and guides, rankings, embeds, SEO dashboard, live llms.txt, IndexNow key, HEAD = GET, robots for AI crawlers
- Buyer cycle: one-box check with register lookup, login gate and return, dashboard checks, watch, permit upload, private report with QR, pay and site visit path
- Translation engine never rewrites a text to itself (fixes a hang on translated check pages during a review), place names and dates inside translated sentences
- Buyer cycle uses the live /api/kb/lookup (register-only pass after the desk review, with developer and permit), legacy registers as fallback
- Hold back sw.js and /saved/ (net zero files while the Pages file limit is fixed); Save offline button appears only once /sw.js is published

items.title: 4 November 2026: 67 changes shipped
items.content_text:
- You can now check a developer for insolvency records and look up whether a property agent is licensed.
- Hazard checks now show flood scenarios for 2030 and 2050, plus protected land and mangroves within 1 km of a project.
- New delivery-delay page and on-time odds lookup show how likely a project is to hand over on schedule.
- A promise tracker, plain-language search alerts and a list of questions to ask the developer are now available.
- A new satellite page uses night lights to spot ghost projects, where nothing visibly changes on site.
- The check, scoring, checklist, about and cases pages are now available in Russian, Chinese, German, French, Arabic and Dutch.

items.title: 3 November 2026: 124 changes shipped
items.content_text:
- Project pages now show what would change a project's score, how old its website is, and whether its promises have drifted over time.
- A new hazards page lets you pin a plot and read flood, earthquake, tsunami and volcano information live, with the source shown for each figure.
- Satellite pages now show radar and monthly photo changes for an area, plus milestone evidence, and they fit phone screens.
- New buyer tools run in your browser: PDF forensics, a payment account check, a contract check and an image check for content credentials.
- Advertised prices are now compared with registered sales, and Dubai prices per square metre are checked against official area data.
- Desk review of project websites got better at reading script-built pages and now says honestly when a site blocks the reader.

Summary written by AI from the day's commits and checked by code.

items.title: 2 November 2026: 26 changes shipped
items.content_text:
- If you paste a link that is not a property project, the check now says so clearly instead of giving a score.
- The buyer portal is now available in Spanish, including the language switch, dates, prompts and messages.
- The portal can read a payment plan with AI. You can also download your data and delete your account.
- Answers from our open data now carry a digital signature, and a public log lets anyone check that the data was not changed.
- On phones, the portal has a bottom bar and a compact header, and findings can be swiped.
- The home page was redesigned. The comparison of buying alone and buying with Kolaboro is now visual, in all 7 languages.

items.title: 1 November 2026: 86 changes shipped
items.content_text:
- Telegram bot webhook (send a project link, get the desk review: missing items, guaranteed-return language, questions), off until the bot token and webhook secret are set
- Off-plan Transparency Index (73 markets ranked live, method, top and bottom 5, sortable table, citation, CSV) and embeddable market widget for journalists (/embed/?m=)
- Shipping-daily ticker on every page (live database numbers plus the dated log of what shipped, fed by the research agents; pauses on hover, static for reduced motion)
- Admin inbox, command palette, live refresh, lead priority, bulk actions, templates; portal getting started, since last visit, compare saved, share with lawyer, print
- Kolaboro security: PayPal receiver check, email verification page, CSV injection, safe project links, admin view token in hash, no session recording on the portal
- Fix a syntax error in the market page renderer; small /api/open/summary for the ticker and live numbers so pages no longer download the full 1.1 MB database file

Summary taken from the day's commit subjects.

items.title: 31 October 2026: 8 changes shipped
items.content_text:
- Project cards now show, for each check, whether it is confirmed, not confirmed, contradicted or backed by a registry, plus how many claims were tested.
- All 328 projects now have all 6 checks, covering 73 markets in 52 countries.
- Live cases now show 100% public (6 of 6) or exactly which checks are missing. There is also a new 100% filter.
- After a check, you can share the result by link, save it as a PDF, and get an email follow-up.
- The sample report is lighter and has photos you can swipe through, a to-do list you can tick, and a share-with-lawyer button.
- A new security page explains who sees your case and how it is stored. A refund line now sits next to prices.

items.title: 29 October 2026: 9 changes shipped
items.content_text:
- You can now request a check and receive a reference for it, so you can follow your request.
- The real buyer portal can now be tried as a read-only demo, so you can look around before signing up.
- Satellite watch is now live on the technology page and updates weekly.
- A new technology page explains how checks work, including comparing building plans with what is actually built.
- Evidence timestamps are now anchored to Bitcoin, and a verify page lets you confirm them yourself.
- A new status page, open data documents and live counters show how the service is running.

items.title: 28 October 2026: 24 changes shipped
items.content_text:
- You can now get a free instant desk review of a project on the check page, before deciding on the paid check.
- The home page now explains the difference between the free desk review and the €490 pre-purchase check.
- You can pay for the pre-purchase check with PayPal. Refund terms are now written out clearly.
- A full sample client report shows the verdict, money paid versus built, nine checks, GPS-verified photos, and plan versus site.
- A live research page covers 122 projects in 9 markets, with a map and a simulator showing how much money is at risk.
- After you pay, you can sign up for a client account and log in to a portal.

items.content_text:

- Badges from the outside website-building tool no longer appear on the site.
- The option to sign in with a social account is hidden for now.
